seoTitle: Language and Region Code Lookup for Hreflang (pt-BR, en-GB)
metaDescription: Search ISO 639-1 languages and ISO 3166-1 regions by name or code, and copy valid hreflang combinations such as pt-BR.
intro: Type Portuguese Brazil or a code and get matching languages, regions and ready combinations.
why:
Hreflang values are language-REGION, and people remember neither list. Search by English name, native name or code. When your search matches both a language and a region the tool offers the combinations, such as pt-BR.

Names come from your browser's Intl data, so they follow current CLDR. A region alone is never valid in hreflang, and the page reminds you to use the language alone unless the versions really differ by country.
howTo: Type a language, a country or a code.
Read the languages and regions found.
Check it in the code checker if unsure.

faq.q: Why are some names in other scripts?
faq.a: The native name appears in brackets so you can recognise the language.
No, Google supports ISO 639-1 two-letter codes.
Search for a letter or common word to browse.
ISO code lists plus Intl.DisplayNames from your browser.
